action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Expat, vendored in ITK incorrectly handled certain
files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash or
execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2022-25235, CVE-2022-25236)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in ITK.
